executive_summary: The Step-6 evidence packet for physics-cm-qm-gr-79-2026-10-11 closes as publishable-pending-owner-approval over a frozen owned frontier: the configured judge set has complete current verdict coverage, the proof-layout gates pass, and the packet records no workflow-owned blockers, deferrals, repeated-repair entries or open pathway obligations, with in-frontier fatal findings carrying recorded repairs. The only active open fatal findings are two read-only mathematics suppliers outside the frontier, recorded as excluded-not-passed - the action-angle definition's missing smooth quotient atlas and the tensor-transition proof's reversed slot factors - and the tensor physics consumer now rests on an independent local construction awaiting an owner seal. Publication stays a deliberate owner decision against the packet's frozen content hash after a personal mathematical audit; this report interprets the packet and does not re-render its ledger or change publication state.
caveats: Active open fatal finding, outside the owned frontier and excluded-not-passed: the published def-action-and-angle-coordinates presents B x (R/Z)^n as a smooth torus without defining a smooth atlas, and its supplied dependencies carry only quotient-topology data; Meinrenken sections 6.1-6.2 (pp.70-74) construct the smooth quotient before defining action-angle coordinates. The interval/box lift charts authored in this run closed only the assigned theorem and radian consumers, so the owner must route mathematics maintenance for the standard quotient atlas and review the original's direct consumers, with the published/imported bytes kept read-only.

Active open fatal finding, outside the owned frontier and excluded-not-passed: the published/imported thm-tensor-transition-laws-define-a-smooth-vector-bundle has Proof 2.1 reversing the slot factors. Under the item's type (r,s)=Mult((T*)^r x T^s, R), the x-to-y component transition uses J on the upper slots and J^{-1} on the lower slots for J=D(y after x^{-1}), so with y0=2x0 the vector partial_x0 has y-component 2, not 1/2; Lee 11.4-11.7 and the local multilinear derivation agree. The original remains open for mathematics maintenance, while the physics consumer def-gr-tensor-fields-and-components now uses the independently proved local lem-gr-tensor-bundle-coordinate-construction, with the owner seal on that local alternative still pending.

The readiness verdict is a workflow reading of one frozen revision: content_sha256 af5c66ece7b634d5a8ded5b8b98ce3c5fbd2a37d6dae927453c60bba64c0d212 and proof-layout fingerprint b162b66ab5853dbc241c948d52c3ee5c55637a2fd064f6862316eff77c807929; judge coverage is complete only for the configured judge set in exactly this frozen context, and judge verdicts are review evidence rather than proofs. Any edit after this packet invalidates the recorded coverage for the edited items and requires the ordinary dependency-ordered review.

Closure bookkeeping is not mathematical or empirical certification: no workflow-owned blocker, deferral, repeated-repair entry or pathway obligation remains, in-frontier fatal findings carry recorded repairs, historical superseded rows are retained only as history, and the single fatal-tier false-positive outcome is recorded with its evidence and no corrective obligation. These facts support readiness, but they do not by themselves establish the repaired items' mathematics beyond their filed proofs, and the two excluded imports stay open.

Publication must preserve the mandatory model-versus-observation separation: the scope includes an experiment item and thought-experiment items whose source-backed observations, apparatus assumptions and uncertainty qualifications form part of their public claim, and neither judge agreement nor workflow closure is empirical confirmation of classical mechanics, quantum mechanics or general relativity.
